audit.reuseReason: The provider's terms prohibit scraping at scale. MITO inspected one public page only to audit one already known archived official row. No bulk street data was copied or redistributed.
audit.authorityCaveat: This is a third-party mirror that names TNREGINET as its upstream source. It is not an official Tamil Nadu Registration Department export and cannot establish a current official value.

matchedRows.locationEvidence: The mirror labels the page SHOLINGANALLUR - 1 under Neelankarai SRO. MITO links the labels to its verified jurisdiction crosswalk only; no official street code or geometry is provided.
matchedRows.limitations: A field match increases confidence that the archived row was transcribed correctly. It does not prove the mirror's freshness, completeness, official street identifier, current value or geometry.

conflicts.interpretation: The two counts may represent different portal query modes, revisions, aggregation rules or source defects. MITO preserves both counts and does not use 758 as the OMR release-gate target until an official current register resolves the discrepancy.
